title: Who’ll read the book? I, said the rook.
html_source:
From the nursery rhyme Cock Robin:

Who’ll be the parson?
I, said the Rook,
with my little book,
I’ll be the parson.

Source: Wikipedia

The first known printed version of the nursery rhyme was published around 1744. The rhyme has been used as a murder archetype in world culture.
